messages:
Elena: Heads-up — we're seeing a bunch of logs that don't have a consistent trace_id field. Need to decide a canonical field name for linking logs <-> traces in the pipeline. Current variants observed: `trace_id`, `traceId`, `trace.trace_id`, `traceId64`, `otel.trace_id`.
Marcus: +1 on normalizing. OTEL semantic convention is `trace_id` on the span but for logs we should probably pick a namespaced field that won't collide. I propose `trace.trace_id` (dot namespace) so forwarders can map multiple trace-like attrs there.
Devon: If we pick `trace.trace_id` we need normalization rules. Some SDKs emit 16-hex (64-bit) trace IDs, others 32-hex (128-bit). Our trace-store expects 32 hex. We should pad 16->32 with left zeros when we detect length 16.
Ravi: Also call out `span_id` vs `trace_id` — logs sometimes include `spanId` only. We should map both `trace.trace_id` and `trace.span_id` and ensure the UI links on trace id first, and span id if trace missing.
Sana: Agree. Also think about cardinality/cost: if we index `trace.trace_id` for every log line that's very high-cardinality. Maybe index it only for the last 30 days or only for logs marked `trace.sampled=true`.
Marcus: Good point. Proposal: ingestion pipeline adds three derived fields: `trace.trace_id` (normalized), `trace.span_id` (normalized), and `trace.sampled` (boolean coerced). Index policy: full index for `trace.sampled==true` (30d default), archival-only for others (no index, stored blob).
Elena: We need a concrete mapping rule for the log-ingest config. Something like:
```yaml
mappings:
  - from: ["trace_id","traceId","otel.trace_id"]
    to: "trace.trace_id"
    transform: |
      if len(value)==16: value = value.rjust(32,'0')
      value = value.lower()
  - from: ["span_id","spanId"]
    to: "trace.span_id"
    transform: "lowercase"
```
Devon: Also ensure we parse header propagation: `traceparent` header should be parsed into the same `trace.trace_id` field if present. And we should prefer explicit trace fields in a log over header-derived ones.
Ravi: On retention/quota UX — update quota docs: linkability increases retention cost. Ops needs a toggle per-customer to cap indexed trace linkage for cost-sensitive tenants.
ingest-bot: deploy:canary mapping v2026.03.18-7 applied to `ingest-canary`. Tests: 3/3 normalization unit tests passed; live sample shows 8% of logs changed field names.
Sana: We'll need SDK guidance pages for Ruby/Go/Node/Python showing how to add `trace.context` to structured logs or rely on OTEL auto-instrumentation. I'll draft a short doc with examples.
Elena: UI/Console: we should add an opt-in setting "Enable trace linking" per org. When enabled, log lines get clickable traces (open trace in new tab). Default off for rollout; canary customers opt-in via support.
Marcus: For rollout, plan: 1) apply ingest mapping to canary (done), 2) collect telemetry (how many logs get normalized, link success rate), 3) enable UI links for canary orgs behind feature flag, 4) evaluate indexing cost delta over 7 days, 5) gradual enable for more orgs.
Devon: Risk/PII: we should avoid exposing raw trace ids in public exports (customer-provided logs forwarded to third parties). Add policy to hash trace ids when forwarding out-of-band. Keep raw for internal linkage only.
Ravi: Suggest storing `trace.trace_id` raw internally and exporting `trace.trace_id_hashed` when forward_to is set. Use HMAC with rotatable key and record key_id used.
Elena: Action items:
- @Sana draft SDK log guidance (PR #???). 
- @Devon extend ingest mapping with header parsing + HMAC export flag (PR #4321).
- @Marcus update quota docs and add org-level flag (RFC draft).
- @Ravi run cost sim for indexing policy (7d canary window).
- @Elena coordinate canary customer list and enable UI flag.
Anyone want to take ownership of the PRs?
Marcus: I'll pick up the RFC + UI flag.
Devon: I'll do the ingest PR and add unit tests for 16->32 padding and `traceparent` parsing.
Sana: I'll draft SDK examples and ping @docs for a short howto.
Ravi: I'll run the cost sim and post numbers in next 48h.
Elena: Great — thanks all. I'll update the rollout checklist and post the canary org list tomorrow.
ingest-bot: test:normalization smoke passed against sample dataset `logs-sample-2026-03-18`, 0.2% false positives (fields that looked like trace ids but were request ids).
